verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for an infrastructure-as-code tool, since run triggers on events are plausible in this category. The evidence pack documents only manually invoked CLI commands (plan, apply, test, import), with nothing that registers rules to fire actions on events. The 'Automate your development workflow' claim describes managing GitHub repositories as code, not event-driven triggers, so it is a different capability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
